source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published article proposes causal k-means clustering, a bias-corrected semiparametric estimator, and root-n asymptotic normality in nonparametric models; the abstract does not state growing-resolution simultaneous profile inference.

The paper constructs simultaneous confidence bands from approximately Neyman-orthogonal score functions and high-dimensional multiplier bootstrap. It does not define or require a lower bound for a causal-quantization ratio denominator \(W(1)\).
The article studies fixed-level vector quantization under a margin condition and supplies nonasymptotic quantization bounds; it does not state growing causal adjacent-profile inference.
The article establishes a central limit theorem for k-means cluster centers from independent sampling on a fixed distribution; it is not a growing-resolution triangular-array result.
